ModulInfo.Title: System Information
ModulInfo.SettingsDesc: Back up or restore extension data to your computer.

ModerationInfo.Title: Moderation
ModerationInfo.Item1: Moderation tools work on channels where you are a moderator or on your own channel.
ModerationInfo.Item2: While cross ban and timeout settings are turned on in other channels, only the cross ban setting is turned on in your own channel.
ModerationInfo.Item3: You must follow the channels you moderate when using cross ban.
ModerationInfo.Item4: You cannot ban or timeout users who are moderators on your own channel, but you can apply a cross ban on other channels you follow and moderate if they are not moderators there.

StreamerModeSettings.Title: Streamer Mode
StreamerModeSettings.Item1: If streamer mode is active, you can see your own chat messages or perform actions in some windows for your own channel.
StreamerModeSettings.Item2: Advanced Moderation Mode activates an advanced moderation panel in user profiles instead of Kick's default panel, offering cross bans, custom timeout times, and a detailed chat history.

LiveNotificationSettings.Title: Stream Notification Settings
LiveNotificationSettings.Item1: You will receive stream notifications for the channels you follow.
LiveNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive sound or visual notifications.
LiveNotificationSettings.Item3: You must be logged in to use this feature.

TagNotificationSettings.Title: Tag Notification Settings
TagNotificationSettings.Item1: You will receive notifications from all clients where you are tagged.
TagNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive sound or visual notifications.
TagNotificationSettings.Item3: Although the message content is visible in the visual notification, it can be partially read later (as far as your OS allows).

ReplyNotificationSettings.Title: Reply Notification Settings
ReplyNotificationSettings.Item1: You will receive a notification when your message is replied to in the chat.
ReplyNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive sound or visual notifications.
ReplyNotificationSettings.Item3: Although the message content is visible in the visual notification, it can be partially read later (as far as the OS allows).

AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Title: Auto Stream Tab
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item1: If the stream audio setting is turned off, it is reapplied on every tab focus or new tab opening.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item2: To prevent sudden sound in the background, streams start muted. You can unmute directly from the top right corner of the Kick player.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item3: Streamer notifications for the streamer you follow must be turned on.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item4: If the stream is already open in any of your tabs, it will be focused, otherwise it will open in a new tab.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item5: When a streamer you follow starts a live broadcast, the stream will automatically open in a new tab.

SidebarChannelBackgroundSettings.Title: Sidebar Channel Background
SidebarChannelBackgroundSettings.Item1: Adds the profile photo of the followed or recommended channels in the left menu as a background.
SidebarChannelBackgroundSettings.Item2: Provides a more aesthetic appearance by applying a blur effect to the background image.

AdBlockerSettings.Title: Ad Blocker
AdBlockerSettings.Item1: Automatically blocks live stream and VOD ads on Kick.
AdBlockerSettings.Item2: Provides an uninterrupted viewing experience by skipping ad segments at the network level without breaking the video stream.
AdBlockerSettings.Item3: After changing the setting, the current stream page will automatically refresh for the setting to take full effect or be deactivated.

StreamPreviewSettings.Title: Stream Preview
StreamPreviewSettings.Item1: Choose from 3 different video player sizes for stream preview.
StreamPreviewSettings.Item2: The player size is set to sm by default.
StreamPreviewSettings.Item3: Allows you to preview the stream in a mini popup window when you hover over channels.

KeywordDetectorSettings.Title: Keyword Detector
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item1: Keyword detector status must be turned on for all features to work.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item2: If any of the words you added appears in a message in the chat, that message will be highlighted with a special animation.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item3: You can customise the word highlight colour as you wish and use the trash can button to return to the default colour.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item4: Messages are marked with a blinking frame to make it easier for you to notice them.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item5: Word searches are case-sensitive. It will match exactly as you added it.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item6: You can enable or disable system (desktop) notifications and sound alerts from the relevant settings.

ModLogsSettings.Title: Moderation Logs
ModLogsSettings.Item1: Shows quick access buttons at the top of the chat, such as audit log, message history, chat clear, and timeouts.

RaidBlockerSettings.Title: Raid Cancellation
RaidBlockerSettings.FollowOnly: Do not go to channels I don't follow
RaidBlockerSettings.Item1: Raid cancellation status must be turned on for all features to be effective.
RaidBlockerSettings.Item2: Add the channels you do not want to go to when a channel does a raid.
RaidBlockerSettings.Item3: If you are logged in, raids to channels you don't follow will be cancelled. This setting is turned on by default.
RaidBlockerSettings.Item4: The system automatically cancels raids within 3 seconds.

EmbedPreviewSettings.Title: Content Viewer
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item1: View X (twitter), youtube, kick and instagram links shared in the chat directly on the page.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item2: When the button is clicked, it displays the content by opening an independent, draggable window in the top left corner.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item3: Choose from 3 different window sizes to preview the content.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item4: The window size is set to sm by default.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item5: You can expand the size of the window that opens in the bottom right corner up to 80% of the page.

RoleHighlightsSettings.Title: Role Highlights
RoleHighlightsSettings.Item1: Highlights the messages from moderators, vip, and og users in the chat.
RoleHighlightsSettings.Item2: A light blue highlight is applied for moderators, turquoise for og, and yellow for vip users.
RoleHighlightsSettings.Item3: If a user has multiple roles, the priority is set as: Moderator > og > vip.

ChannelHiderSettings.Title: Channel Hider
ChannelHiderSettings.Item1: The channel hide status must be turned on for all features to work.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item2: To hide a channel, simply click the ⊘ blocked button in the recommended channels or the playing stream on the homepage.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item3: You can find and remove the channels you have hidden from the Channel Hider menu in the extension window.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item4: Add the channels you do not want to see to the recommended channels list on the left and the auto-playing recommended channels on the homepage.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item5: The channels you add will not be shown in the recommended streams section on the homepage.

ViewerCountSettings.Title: Viewer Count
ViewerCountSettings.Item1: Allows you to see the hidden viewer count of a broadcasting channel while you are watching.

EmotePreviewSettings.Title: Emote Preview
EmotePreviewSettings.Item1: Choose from 3 different window sizes for emote preview.
EmotePreviewSettings.Item2: The window size is set to sm by default.
EmotePreviewSettings.Item3: Allows you to see an enlarged version and details of the emote in a mini popup window when you hover over emotes in the chat.

ChannelThemeSettings.Title: Set Channel Theme
ChannelThemeSettings.EmptyThemes: No channels with a saved theme
ChannelThemeSettings.Item1: Change the backgrounds or text colours of any channel. These colour pickers will be increased.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item2: With the colour picker to the right of the palette, you can choose any hues from anywhere.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item3: Although the entered channel names are fetched automatically, you can also type and add different channels manually.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item4: You can select the channel from the saved themes section and change the colour palette or delete it.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item5: While the global theme setting is on, you can set a common theme independent of channels and pages, and make it valid on all pages where no custom theme is set.

LiveViewerCountTracker.TooltipLine1: These values are mathematically calculated based on the current viewer count.
LiveViewerCountTracker.TooltipLine2: The statistics are re-evaluated from that moment on at every channel switch.

ModPanel.Title: KT with dp | Moderation
ModPanel.CrossReasonNote: Cross ban information will automatically be added to the reason.

Tooltips.TargetMod: The target user is a moderator in this channel, so the action will not be applied. You can only use cross ban.
Tooltips.StreamerModeMod: Streamer mode is active. The target user is a moderator in this channel, so the action will not be applied here. The action will only be applied in your own channel (or others if cross ban is on).
Tooltips.StreamerModeBoth: Streamer mode is active. The action will be applied in both this channel and your own channel.
Tooltips.StreamerModeOnlyYours: Streamer mode is active. Because you are not a moderator in this channel, the action will be applied based on your own channel.
